title: Inovar Packaging Group
description: inovarpackaging.com Inovar Packaging Group (Irving, TX) is a PE-backed buy-and-build platform producing pressure-sensitive labels, shrink sleeves, flexible packaging, and RFID — 14 US plants, 12+ acquisitions since 2016 (latest: Kiliper Corp, Feb 2026). Owned by Kelso & Company since May 2022 (previously AEA Investors); CEO/Chairman Jeff Brezek leads, with deal advisors Milbank and Mesirow confirming real M&A scale. Revenue is private and undisclosed — realistic estimates put it at $100–250M, with ~500–750 employees (Form 5500 filings show plan participants growing 121→743 in 2020–2024). Certifications are strong: ISO 9001/14001, first US printer with GMI Platinum (both digital + flexo; serves CVS, Target, Walgreens, Home Depot), FDA 21 CFR 11 / EU Annex 11, EcoVadis Gold; won the 2024 TLMI Eugene Singer Award. Clients: food & beverage, healthcare, ag-chem, supplements, personal care — with built-in redundancy across plants for continuity.
